lines.en: You look troubled, Gita. Did something happen at work yesterday?
lines.pt: Você parece preocupado, Gita. Aconteceu alguma coisa no trabalho ontem?

lines.en: My manager asked me to sign a report that I knew was wrong. What would you have done?
lines.pt: Minha gerente me pediu para assinar um relatório que eu sabia que estava errado. O que você teria feito?

lines.en: I would have refused to sign it. But what did you do in the end?
lines.pt: Eu teria me recusado a assinar. Mas o que você fez no fim?

lines.en: I signed it, and I felt terrible. If I had refused, I think I would have lost my job.
lines.pt: Eu assinei e me senti péssimo. Se eu tivesse me recusado, acho que teria perdido o emprego.

lines.en: Maybe. What would you have said if she had fired you on the spot?
lines.pt: Talvez. O que você teria dito se ela tivesse demitido você na hora?

lines.en: I would have asked for a written explanation. Where would I have found another job so quickly?
lines.pt: Eu teria pedido uma explicação por escrito. Onde eu teria achado outro emprego tão rápido?

lines.en: Fair point. If I had been in your position, I might have done the same, to be honest.
lines.pt: Justo. Se eu estivesse na sua posição, talvez tivesse feito o mesmo, para ser sincero.

lines.en: Really? I thought you would have been braver. What would your wife have said about it?
lines.pt: Sério? Achei que você teria sido mais corajoso. O que a sua esposa teria dito sobre isso?

lines.en: She would have told me to protect my family first. Who would have helped us otherwise?
lines.pt: Ela teria me dito para proteger minha família primeiro. Quem nos teria ajudado, senão?

lines.en: That is a real dilemma. Now I need to decide what to do about the report.
lines.pt: É um dilema de verdade. Agora preciso decidir o que fazer sobre o relatório.

lines.en: You could talk to human resources. What would have happened if you had spoken up sooner?
lines.pt: Você poderia falar com o RH. O que teria acontecido se você tivesse falado antes?

facts.label: 3º condicional em perguntas
facts.sub: Pergunte com would + sujeito + have + particípio: What would you have done? Responda: I would have refused.

facts.label: eu teria + particípio
facts.sub: A resposta usa would have + particípio: I would have refused. I would have asked for an explanation. Fale do que você faria, mas não fez.

facts.label: se + tivesse + particípio
facts.sub: Para dar a condição, use had + particípio: What would you have said if she had fired you? Se eu tivesse recusado, eu teria perdido o emprego.

solo: Pergunte em que situação o aluno já passou por isso.

compare.br: Em português, perguntamos “o que você teria feito?” e respondemos “eu teria recusado”.
compare.us: Em inglês, a pergunta é What would you have done? Use would + sujeito + have + particípio. A resposta é I would have + particípio. Use if + had + particípio para a condição.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: What would you have done?
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

items.s: What would you have done? asks about an imaginary past.
We say “What would you have do?”
items.why: We say What would you have done?

items.s: I would have refused means I did refuse.
items.why: It means you did not, but imagine it.

answers: What would you have done? asks about an imaginary past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “What would you have do?” → Falso (We say What would you have done?)
I would have refused means I did refuse. → Falso (It means you did not, but imagine it.)

pages.title: A hard choice in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a snowy afternoon in downtown Denver. Earl and Tom meet at their favorite café. Tom sits with his coat still on. He stirs his coffee for a long time without drinking it. Earl notices that his friend is not himself today. He puts down his newspaper and waits.

“You look troubled, Tom. Did something happen at work yesterday?” says Earl. “My manager asked me to sign a report that I knew was wrong. What would you have done?” says Tom. “I would have refused to sign it. But what did you do in the end?” says Earl.

pages.title: A hard choice in Denver · 3/3
paragraphs: “That is a real dilemma. Now I need to decide what to do about the report.” says Tom. “You could talk to human resources. What would have happened if you had spoken up sooner?” says Earl. Tom finally drinks his cold coffee. Earl offers to go with him to the meeting. They agree to talk to human resources on Monday. Outside, the snow keeps falling on the mountains. Tom feels lighter after telling the whole story. Hard questions are easier to answer with a friend.
